notes: THE PICK, 2026-11-17, made for him on his word and not yet ordered ("you be an expert interio designer, pick for me ... pick the best one, I prefer larger ove rsmall, lots of space there"), after the first pick was corrected: Andrew, 2026-11-17, of the DynJest island table picked for him: "1st pick doest have wheels, wheels are mandatory". Slot: the kitchen face of the 51" wall whose living-room face holds the Decofy console (F-71), taken as the same 51" on the kitchen side, untaped. Fit: 46" leaves 5" of the 51"; 22" deep, so 58" from the wall keeps a 36" walkway and 64" a 42" work aisle: one tape before he orders, the kitchen being unmeasured (his word: "lots of space there"); 36" tall, counter height. Why: on wheels, as he requires (four swivel casters hidden behind a plinth, two with brakes), and the largest and heaviest of the rolling pieces read: a fixed 46 x 22" rubberwood top (Qsun's is 45.5 x 17.5" plus a leaf on brackets), 127.2 lb, a center drawer and two side drawers, a double-door cabinet on soft-close hinges with an adjustable shelf, and open shelves at both ends. 4.6 stars (570): 77 / 14 / 5 / 2 / 2 %; Amazon's Choice; its summary of the reviews: "well-made, sturdy, and worth its price", "wheels roll nicely but are difficult to lock"; reviews on the page: "Even though it has wheels, it doesn't look like a rolling cart. Looks more like furniture", "It's hefty, sturdily put together", "the top is sturdy & sealed". Against it, said in the reply: a long build, about 50 panels in two boxes that can arrive on different days ("It took my husband 3 hrs", "I took 9 hours to build this and I'm very experienced"); the top's finish ("doesn't have a durable enough finish for kitchen use. Kneading a bread will probably ruin it"), so cut and knead on a board; the brakes are hard to reach. Color (F-68): Black, the designer's call: on the white marble a dark piece carries the contrast ((10); he found the ash table "too light on white marble" and a pale clock "too bland" in the same zone), stark white beside honey wood and cream walls reads badly ((8)), and the rubberwood top repeats the maple cabinets; his own two cart picks were white, so the White (B0BQ67M7MR) is named beside it: $279.99, "Only 7 left in stock", FREE delivery Wednesday, November 25, black bar pulls. Black: list $249.99, "Exclusive Prime price", In Stock, FREE delivery November 20 - 23; ships from and sold by Yaheetech; "Returnable until Jan 31, 2027"; Amazon offers assembly for $229.99, not taken. Lock both brakes where it parks, since Maddie can push a cart on marble (F-21). Flags: none from the vocabulary; the walkway is unchecked. rooms: the brief.
